title: ShellCanvas Database
description: Browse database schemas, run SQL, inspect typed results and export CSV.
style: :root{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#e8edf5;background:#111722;color-scheme:dark}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0}button,textarea,input{font:inherit}main{height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column}header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:18px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid #2b3545;background:#151d29}h1{font-size:22px;margin:2px 0}.eyebrow{margin:0;color:#78a9ff;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:700}#provider{padding:6px 10px;border-radius:20px;background:#233149;color:#9cc2ff;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12px}.notice{padding:9px 22px;background:#332b17;color:#f3d487;font-size:13px}.workspace{display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:0;flex:1}aside{border-right:1px solid #2b3545;overflow:auto;padding:14px;background:#131a25}.side-head,.result-head,.toolbar,.pager{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.side-head button{padding:3px 9px}details{margin-top:8px}summary{cursor:pointer;color:#b8c9e5}.table{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;background:transparent;color:#dbe7fa;padding:5px 8px 5px 18px}.table:hover{background:#202b3d}.work{padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;gap:8px}label{font-size:12px;color:#9fadbf}textarea{height:130px;resize:vertical;border:1px solid #34445c;border-radius:6px;background:#0b111a;color:#eef5ff;padding:12px;font:13px/1.5 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}button{border:1px solid #3a4b65;border-radius:5px;background:#202b3d;color:#e9f1ff;padding:7px 12px;cursor:pointer}button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#2a3950}button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}.primary{background:#2563a8;border-color:#3b82d0}.toolbar{justify-content:flex-start}.toolbar #status{margin-left:auto;color:#a8b5c8;font-size:13px}#warnings{color:#f0bd68;font-size:12px;min-height:16px}.result-head{margin-top:6px}.safe{margin-right:10px}.grid-wrap{border:1px solid #2c384a;overflow:auto;min-height:180px;flex:1;background:#0d131d;position:relative}table{border-collapse:collapse;min-width:100%;font:12px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}th,td{border-right:1px solid #283446;border-bottom:1px solid #283446;padding:7px 9px;text-align:left;white-space:pre;max-width:420px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#192230;color:#afc7ea}.cell-null{color:#75849a;font-style:italic}.cell-binary{color:#d9a6ff}.cell-unsupported{color:#f0a26b}#empty{padding:28px;color:#748399}.pager{justify-content:flex-end;font-size:12px;color:#99a8bd}@media(max-width:700px){.workspace{grid-template-columns:1fr}aside{display:none}.work{padding:10px}}
